  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3157,"var":"c","code":"if (c != 3 && c != 1 && c != 4) return stbi__err(\"bad component count\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The decoder accepts the attacker-selected 4-component JPEG frame and continues processing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3173,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4);  if (!z->img_comp[i].h || z->img_comp[i].h > 4) return stbi__err(\"bad H\",\"Corrupt JPEG\");","note":"The patched SOF sampling nibble is accepted, even though it creates an unusual 4:1-style geometry for one component."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3184,"var":"v_max","code":"if (z->img_comp[i].v > v_max) v_max = z->img_comp[i].v;","note":"The decoder computes the maximum vertical factor from the attacker-controlled components, so the malformed geometry propagates into later resampling decisions."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs      = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"The crafted component factors are reduced by integer division, creating the fractional subsampling mismatch associated with the issue."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3768,"var":"r->resample","code":"else if (r->hs == 2 && r->vs == 1) r->resample = stbi__resample_row_h_2;","note":"One component is routed into the horizontal 2x resampler, a specialized path that assumes canonical JPEG sampling relationships."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_h_2","line":3345,"var":"out[i*2+1]","code":"out[i*2+1] = stbi__div4(input[w-2]*3 + input[w-1] + 2);","note":"The horizontal 2x resampler expands each row according to the derived factor; if the component geometry is inconsistent with the actual data, the write pattern can extend beyond the intended row extent."}
]
JSON
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
